Greetings from the October Games Studio! 

Horror Legends summer update is now live! Listed below are the full patch notes you can expect in the new version of the game!

OBJECTIVE SYSTEM
The objective system has been completely redesigned.
 Objective system that has 3 phases to complete, designed to keep cast more engaged during game play.
 Objective Prompts designed to keep you informed on what to do next

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/c76217a5ad73bff5f07b4aaeb859133abb7dde91.gif

 Nana the Witch has been added to the game and functions alongside the new objective system.
 Use witchcraft to dismantle demonic effigies preventing your escape!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/720716fa43442d4b218d60be8fab47927c35b562.gif

 The Matriarch a malevolent and powerful witch has been added to the game and will attack the Cast 1 by 1 if the objectives have not been completed after a certain amount of time.
 In phase 3 you can stand in Nana’s radius to speed up the escape portal spawn time. If they legend collides with Nana's player model it will freeze the escape timer and reveal all cast.
 The escape zone has now been turned into a teleport zone that will teleport you into Nana’s hideout.
 Inside Nana’s hideout there is a teleport zone that will take you back into the map if you wish to go back and try to save someone.

DOWNED STATE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/c0d828ad34074f3d57bcda6a73206ead1be54261.gif

 Another massive update to the game where all Cast and even some Legends will enter a downed state when they run out of Health. 
 A down player will auto recover if they enter downed state after and extended period of time.
 Allies can expedite the recovery of a downed player by healing them when they hold the "Use" button.

Legends will be able to perform Finishers on downed players complete with a gruesomely animated cutscene!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/080c748d5e5e692e8522f69e1c7053b77bc94138.gif

 Once they have entered the vulnerable state Legend can hold the use button and activate the Finisher.
 A player entering the downed state for the first time will have a short duration of time where they are protected from the Legend's Finisher.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/e7f33fe56435513067480b45fc20ad8889a3bf75.gif


 A Legend's Finisher can be interrupted if they take any damage while doing the finisher before the killing blow.  


CONTROLS
 The game now has Controller support!
 All the controls in the game are FULLY customizable!
 The default drop Item key bind is now set to “G”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/7b31f6a4132b9dd3789addd0d294d7b73ed9bb6a.png



LEGENDS
All legend’s have had their Night Vision reduced. 
 All travel modes now have a cooldown when you start the match.
 Some Legend Weapons now have a max charge time so you can't hold your charge forever! 

Punkie (Human)
 added a downed state
 Will now be invulnerable for a short period of time after leaving downed state
 added a kill mechanic
 added a Faze that will teleport him away from cast players
 added a travel mode


Punkie
Remastered original Punkies Skins.
Added 6 new Punkie Skins!
increased movement speed from 4.21 to 4.31
Increased Poison splinter damage and now does fear damage instead of static reveal. 

Edith
 Added a Alternate ability (“Pounce”) That can be unlocked for 5000 Fate points and selected in the character select screen, 
 Pounce ability - Edith will lunge forward and attack with a devastating attack after a delay. The attack does 125 damage if you land it having the ability to down a cast member in 1 hit with the trade off that it's very hard to land. 
 Flurry Default main attack has been adjusted - Edith's flurry attack no longer has a charge. Both left and right click attacks have zero cooldown. With the left click doing 4 points less damage but doing 8 points of stamina damage. 
Reduced Edith's Teleport stamina cost from 20 to 15
Removed Stamina drain from AI Edith
 Added 3 holy water spawns in Edith’s game mode for a total of 10 up from 7 on all maps.

Werewolf 
 Added a Alternate ability (“Bloody Roar”) That can be unlocked for 5000 Fate points and selected in the character select screen, 

Killer Keith
 Increased Travel Mode timer to 60 seconds from 30 seconds.

Corey
Knife charges are now unlimited but with a cool down.
Adjusted her health to 70 hp
Added a travel mode

Psycho Phil 
 Max Run speed has been increased from 4.1 to 4.31
 Crossbow Damage has be reduced to 10 from 25
 Crossbow Stamina damage has been reduced from 20 to 10
 now does 50 fear damage instead of static reveal.


CAST
 You can now perform a finishing kill on the Werewolf if you have the Silver Sword
 All cast have had their Sprint and walk speed increased Slightly

Maps
Cut scenes have been added to the game before you begin a match and after one is over.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/711b2037d2e5be4a8fbf735a01f5f154c2e89df3.gif

Salvage Yard
Improved Design
Improved Key Spawns
Improved Item Spawns	
Adding more environmental storytelling

Cabin
 Complete redesign of the map
 Added a Boat House
Added a Cave
Updated Vegetation
Redesigned the terrain
 Improved Crouch Zones

Farm House
 Improved Crouch zones

Dream Realm and Hedge maze have been remove and are currently being reworked for our new objective system. They will return! 

UI, HUD & Menus
The UI HUD in game has been revised and improved. 
All characters in the game have unique Illustrated Portraits Icons that reflect their Fear and Health state.  
Legends can now see portraits of all cast players but their portraits will be hidden until that cast has been revealed. 
Added cooldown and charge graphic in the ability hud to let the player know how long they can charge their weapon for and how long the cooldown will be until they can use it again.
 If the player is gaining health their health bar will flash green.
 If the player is gaining stamina their stamina bar will flash green. 
 The End Game and Tab screens have been reworked
Objective prompts have been added to help new player during each phase of the match.
 Players now have their names and health bars shown above their head if you are within a certain radius of them.
Added interaction Icons to give more feedback when the player can interact with something.
 Added a Dark red background to the health bar of the downed player to show the threshold in which that player's health needs to be at to be revived. 
 The health bar has been updated from just a number to now showing a number with a bar.
 The Ui at the top shows a representation of which phase the match is in and the number of currently active effigies
 The game's menus have been made simpler and more user friendly.

GENERAL
 Added a feature where if you use certain abilities it will automatically revert back to your default attack ability.
Added a Crouch Jump animation.

NPC’s
 The Cops and Harbinger NPC's will be able to revive downed players!
 NPCS’s are now affected by hazard zones.
 NPC’s now have a hit reaction animation when taking damage
 NPC’s now have a jump animation.
 NPC’s have a blood effects when hit.

Doors
 Improved Door physics, you can now close a door on a legends face and it wont get stuck.

Music and Sound
 New sound effects have been added and many of the game's sound effects have been improved. 
 Psycho Phil, Matriarch, and Werewolf Music Themes have been added to the game
 Psycho Phil and Werewolf Fear music themes have been added to the game

Concept Art
Added 18 extra concept art that can be unlocked with fate. 



BUG FIXES
Fixed a Bug where the cat would reveal from very far away.
 Fixed a bug that a spectator bug that would lock UI elements to screen when the game would end
Fixed a Bug where Edith wouldn't teleport always once her stamina was at zero if she was in the air.
 Fixed a bug that wouldn’t let you swap with Ai Edith's if you were outside 100 meters. 
 Fixed a bug that would cause Edith players and her AI to be unkillable
 Fixed a bug that would cause AI ravers to get stuck in their sliding or dancing animation state
 Fixed a bug that would cause some elements in the game to teleport to different locations when the host left the server
Fixed a bug that would cause the harbinger to damage cast players
Fixed a bug in the esc menu in game where the resume button would stop working
Fixed a bug that where cops bullets were doing no damage
Fixed a bug where some AI would ignore doors
 Fixed a bug with AI Corey's attack box turning into a collider when you would kill her. 



This has been one of the biggest updates for Horror Legends. We are excited for you to play the new release and would love to hear your feedback! Connect with us and our community on our discord! https://discord.gg/aqAMKHP

See you in game! 
October Games Team.

notes.title: Horror Legends: Version 0.2.8 Preview
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Over here at October Games Drake and I have been hard at work developing a new update for Horror Legends. The update will feature some big changes that will drastically change and improve how the game is played. We are very excited and wanted to communicate with you on some of the changes we have been working on.

Doors
Doors will now open both ways and will always open away from the way you are facing.
We received a lot of feedback from players that they did not enjoy doors opening only 1 way and we agreed that even though it’s less realistic, it provides much better gameplay.

If you crouch and open a door it will open silently
we felt like this was something important to HL as there was never a way to open doors silently but now all of those players looking for more stealthy gameplay will have fun with this one ;)

Some Doors will have deadbolt locks on them that you will be able to lock and unlock.
we always had the intention of adding this, without it cast don’t have many options when getting chased and now they will have opportunities to quickly close and lock a door on a legend.

Some Doors will require a key or a special tool to unlock.
We felt this was essential to horror legends going forward, We wanted to have the ability to lock certain powerful weapons and items behind these doors like the silver sword to kill the werewolf as one example. It also allows us to create sections of a map, buildings, or rooms that can only be accessed  by finding a key which creates a mini objective to progress to these areas.

Keys and Tools
Keys can now be found on the map to unlock specific doors. 
Some Doors might require a special tool like bolt cutters to open for example.


Knockback Mechanic
Certain attacks and weapons can now knock back a player pushing them in the direction the attacking player is facing.
This Mechanic is so cool, using the bat to knock back Killer Kieth just feels so good, it gives certain attacks so much more utility and it's just one more way a player can save themselves in a chase.

Here are some of the Items and attacks that have a knockback

 Shove
 Bat
 Pitchfork
 Shotgun
 Revolver


Movement Speed Damage 
We now have the ability to create weapons, attacks, and aoe abilities / zones that will slow your movement speed. At this time we have yet to implement this in any specific way but some ways we have talked about implementing it are on Killer Kieth’s Attacks and his gas cloud. 

Jumping
When you are out of stamina you will still be able to jump.
This change was a lot more complicated than it seems, jumping will still deplete your stamina but you’ll be able to jump when you have no stamina. We knew it was frustrating not being able to jump out of the lava in the dream realm if you fell in with no stamina. This change should help players platform and run from the legend by jumping up hay bails and into a window if you are out of stamina.

Jumping now has a very very short cooldown to prevent bunny hopping.
Bunning hopping was never intended for our game as it looks and feels unrealistic, the cooldown is very short and shouldn't really be noticeable also providing a more realism as you can’t really jump consecutively very fast in real life. We have the ability to change what this cooldown will be, our plan is to find a sweet spot that prevents bunning hoping while still feeling fluid and nice.

Stamina
We are reworking the Stamina system, Giving players a lot more stamina but having the stamina regeneration rate be a lot slower. We are hoping that this will make players use their stamina more wisely and also incentivize them to walk and couch more as you will need to do this to regen your stamina. This also means that items that regen your stamina will be a lot more useful while attacks that deplete stamina will be a lot more effective. This will be a big change and we will keep a close eye on how this plays out. 

Stealth
We are thinking about ways to shift horror legends to have more elements of stealth gameplay to it. Right now the balance is heavily focused on finding items and the objective as quickly as possible. We want to provide players another avenue to achieve these same tasks but from a stealthy perspective. We will be keeping an eye and talking about how we can do this going into the future so along with doors opening silently when crouched, we have reduced the audio of the walking and crouch footstep volumes for all characters. (mind you the discrepancy of volume between characters will still remain depending on their stealth stat value). 

Animations
We are currently remastering all of the Cast’s third person animations. 

Maps
New Map Salvage Yard The Birthplace of Killer Keith, littered with jun, filth, and an ominous fog that looms over the yard. You'll be unsure of what will be lurking around each corner. The map will be a perfect addition as it's layout and feel is like any other that is currently in game. 

Farmhouse has had a massive redesign to its vegetation, There were issues that the old vegetation was causing on performance and we are hoping that this map will be much more optimized now. The corn-maze has changed and there are updates to some of the buildings on the map to make the map more interesting and have more character. 

Cabin has also had a big redesign in its vegetation, the same performance issues were plaguing the cabin. Also several points of interest have been added to the map to give it more character. 

New Playable Cast Member
You will now be able to play as the raver that is featured in the pregame mode.

Corey Sisley
New AI
	We have added an AI companion to Corey’s kit; another Corey posing as one of her decoys. If a Cast Member is in range it will attack them revealing them to the Legend.  We have been keeping a close eye on Corey, her kit has taken a hit after we had to remove players turning into Corey’s when they die, this decoy change will help her tracking a lot and should add some spook, we have been looking at ways reintroduce dead players turning into Coreys 

Character Controller update
	Players will no longer be able to stick to and climb steep walls. 
We never wanted players to be able to do this and it was just a by-product of the system we had. We have finally been able to update our programming to reflect this change.

Spectator Mode
Players will now be able to spectate games; by pressing escape and clicking the spectate option in the menu screen or in the character select screen. 
This feature has been long overdue and we know many of you have been asking for it! 

Items spawn system 
	The Item spawn system has had a massive overhaul. Now each match there will be a much more random set of items you are given. The way our old system worked wasn’t reliable and limited us from what we could ultimately do. We will have the ability to create much more random and interesting spawn sets for each map making each match feel a bit more unique. 

Your feedback is so important to us and we want to thank all of you who have expressed your opinions. We encourage you to keep providing feedback. Any thoughts about this preview please share them on our discord. The projected timeline for these features is undetermined but hopefully in the month of May you can expect to see these updates. If you’re interested in testing some of the features sooner, we will be releasing a test build in the coming weeks. So stay tuned and we really appreciate everyone who helps us test the game! 


Nicholas Haye a.k.a Spectral Fields 
Game Designer / Music Composer

New Legend: Killer Keith

A slow but powerful Legend that leverages stealth to close in on his victims. Killer Keith has rapid health regeneration, so you’ll need to call the cops or gang up if you want to kill him. One on One fights are suicide. Although slow, Killer Keith doesn’t use stamina while power walking. However the Cast can still exhaust him with stamina damage to slow him down to base walking speed. 

Abilities
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/164bf9fbf8f727fe6da01668ae986883a81a66db.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/eb376c4c71e6cae014385015425b731ea778e88c.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/6da47d8e5d38292fc29c76c8bf1e08b8b1f248e1.png

 Combat Knife: Primary Attack is pretty basic, but a fully charged Secondary Attack will not only severely damage a Cast Member, but reveal them for a substantial amount of time. 
 Rebar: If you have trouble closing in you can throw a very large piece of Rebar at fleeing Cast Members.
 Chemicals: Create gas clouds in the map that drain Cast health and Stamina if they enter. Great for creating choke points. 


Specters and Killer Keith’s Post Game: If you are killed by Killer Keith you will become a ghostly Specter. While you can no longer interact with living players you can shorten the game’s timer by activating randomly spawned spirit energy. Doing so will help the Cast chances to escape and give you a generous XP boost. You can also haunt the map by destroying lights, windows, and opening and closing doors. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/c1510486740efdca2eae1a8bdcecdf6c7b3e3890.png


New Objective

Call the Cops. You can now call the cops if you find a randomly spawned radio in the map. The radio is attached to a dead police office most likely an early victim of the Legend. Make the call and AI Cops will enter the map to help you face the Legend. If the Legend takes damage from the Cops, it will be revealed to the Cast for a short amount of time. This is your chance to attack if you are trying to kill it. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/a93bb0d1e53a591016dff8eec1095bc85246329d.png

Cast Updates

Inventory: The Cast now have various inventory slots available to them depending on which one you are playing as. For example Stevie Lint has 4 inventory slots available to him while Ryan only has two. You can see your inventory on the bottom of the screen. Use the number keys to switch between them. This also applies to Legend abilities as well. 


Consumables: Candy and Beer will now be removed from your inventory when you run out of charges.

Third-person: Cast are now able to use a third person camera! Great for peeking around corners...

New NPCs

Black Cat: Watch your step, you may cross paths with a black cat. If you do it hiss at you revealing you to the Legend for a short amount of time. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/2f26ffdb9f7e39d4b490dee1a0c3ebd6c95f9fce.png

Harbinger:  A stranger wanders the maps of Horror Legends. If he finds you he may give you a consumable item after warning you of the horrors that await you. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/97923b9ce7f08c231d31009bf627951ebfffccd6.jpg

Cops: If called, these boys in blue will report to the closest Cast member and act as a bodyguard. Again, if they successfully attack the Legend it will be revealed to you for a short amount of time.
 

Mechanics / Features

3D Voice Chat: Voice chat now works in Horror Legends. However you can only hear who ever is nearby. Great for eavesdropping!

Reveal Icon: This will appear accompanied right above your health to let you know that you can be seen by the other team. If you see this don’t try to hide, RUN!  (Note: AI Gourd are drawn to Revealed players.) 

Stamina Update: Exhausting Stamina will now trigger a taunt for the Cast. Legend Exhaust sounds are more noticeable. Listen for the queues so you know when its time to run away! 

Nightvision: Legends can now see in the dark by pressing V. Each Legends have different strengths of Night Vision for balance. Happy hunting.

Map Updates


 All Vegetation have improved graphics and performance.
 Maps have new lighting to improve the atmosphere and spook factor. Use your Flashlights and Night Vision!
 New creepy background music for the Cabin by Spectral Fields. 
 Drastically increased item spawns.

 Improved Cabin’s fireplace particle effects and lighting.
 Improved Glyph spawn points.

 Improved Punkie Animations
 Improved Glyph graphics
 Replaced Gourd attack sounds. 
 Decreased everyone’s running speed slightly. 
 Replaced Door sound effects. 
 Replaced Shotgun sound.
 Replaced Punch sound.
 Decreased Pistol damage slightly.
 The Shotgun and Revolver do mild stamina damage.
 Replaced blood impact effects.
 Increased Gourd Stamina regeneration rate.




After this update we plan of focusing more on content rather than features. So expect more maps, items, and characters in the next month or so. I planned to create a Game Guide for all the new features but ran out of time. For now, I hope these patch notes will suffice until I can make a proper in game guide. However it is now time for me to prepare for my wedding and pack from my honeymoon! Before I go I just want to say thanks again for all your support. Without it updates like this wouldn't be possible. Have fun killing each other I’ll see you all in a week!

Drake: Lead Game Designer.
